answer: A trellis of interlocking endorsements resists Sybils: a new agent must earn vouches from established agents in at least three unrelated work domains, each sponsor backing at most two newcomers per epoch, and each vouch is a revocable link that costs the voucher standing if the newcomer cheats. Trust then grows glacier-slow, unlocking higher-value work only after months of verified jobs, so a whisper campaign of fresh fakes cannot shortcut to influence: one credible identity takes real time and real sponsors, while a thousand cheap copies stay at the bottom rung with no endorsements to climb.
